notes.title: DrumBeats VR into Full Release!
notes.content:
Dear players,

It is time.


One of the biggest milestones (both personal and development-wise) has been achieved: Music from a major label/publisher.

While development will most certainly continue, the addition of well-known music has led to the game going into full release.

Does this mean it's finished? No, far from it. This is just the beginning of a new era - with so much more on the planning (hint, more music).

A brief overview of the latest additions:

Four new songs
One new environment
Stage level additions
Several bugfixes
Re-added SteamVR Support


Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch v0.73.1
notes.content:
Dear players,

Patch 0.73.1 is out and contains several bugfixes and improvements.


There was an error with the "Auw-some" achievement, which made it impossible to achieve - this has been fixed now.
The stiffness of the cymbals has been increased. This allows for easier hits when there are a lot of cymbal-notes.
A changelog has been added in the main-menu.



Enjoy!

notes.title: DrumBeats VR Major Update v0.73.0
notes.content:
Dear players, 

update 0.73 is out now and is packed with new features and improvements. See the full release notes below:


New UI: Enjoy a completely redesigned, more intuitive interface.
Ride Cymbal: Expand your sound with the newly added Ride Cymbal.
Movable Drums: Adjust your kit layout to your liking (default and leftie kits supported).
Spectator Free Cam: Take control of what's on your computer screen—press 'Tab' to explore your kit from any angle.
Ghost Notes: Elevate your technique with subtle, nuanced ghost notes.
Achievements: Earn bragging rights with new in-game achievements!
Golden Notes: Hit these notes for an even bigger combo!
MIDI Input & Output: Connect and customize with full MIDI mapping options.
Easier Stick Calibration: Faster, more accurate setup for a smoother start.
Improved Audio Sync: Improved sync for a better drumming experience.
New Tutorial: Dive into our enhanced tutorial.
Crash-fixes: Improved the overall stability and memory usage.
Reverb Wet Mix Setting: If you'd like some more (or less) reverb, you can now change the reverb mix in the settings.


Enjoy!

notes.title: MAJOR Update
notes.content:
BIG UPDATE


Dear Players,

I'm pleased to announce the latest update, bringing a range of new features and improvements to enhance your VR drumming experience:

New Content

 Introducing 4 new songs to diversify your playlist.
 Explore the addition of the Stage Environment and Show (currently available in one song).
 Immerse yourself in the new Synthwave Environment.


Enhancements

ASIO support (drums only) for ultra low-latency
MIDI output (beta)
Improved Movement Tracking.
Increased Performance.
Improved visual quality with Improved Graphics.
Test your skills against others on the Leaderboards.
Drum with more realistic sounds thanks to Improved Drum Sounds.



Enjoy!

notes.content:

The stick-rebound (beta) setting didn't work correctly (it was always on) which is now fixed.
Also, an option to use your keyboard as bassdrum input has been added.

Enjoy!

notes.title: DrumBeatsVR v0.60.9 Released
notes.content:
Dear players,

Amongst some bugfixes and clarifications, this update contains:



Three new songs
A new environment
Pause button moved to system pause button (instead of B/Y, Oculus touch controller only)


Note:
This update, and upcoming updates, will affect the beta version only. We are moving all content/features to the beta version. Once that is complete, the beta will become the stable version.

To clarify;
The beta exists on the default branch (no need to opt-in to beta). Upon launch you can select the version you want to play.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Beta update!
notes.content:
Dear players,

It has been a while, but we are proud to show you what we've been working on!
Amongst many improvements, the new beta includes:

A completely new, built from the ground up, physics system.
Major optimization has been done to ensure a smooth experience
Fresh UI
A proper tutorial
AV-Sync setting
Overall new styling
Better support for race-pedals (although only the bassdrum is working at the moment)


While it's not finished (yet), please have a look and let us know what you think!
To play the beta, make sure you have the latest update.
When you start the game, you can choose between the release version and the beta version.

notes.title: Major DrumbeatsVR Update!
notes.content:
Dear players,

The new version of DrumbeatsVR is live!

In this update you'll find:


New hit detection built from scratch.
Two new songs.
Moving cymbals (physics based).
New environments (Hell is replaced by the Stage, the Studio got an upgrade).
You can now select an environment for the custom.
Drum-sounds can be turned on or off in Arcade and Custom mode.


Have fun!

notes.title: DrumbeatsVR Major Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Dear players,

After a long moment of silence we are proud to announce that a big update is coming soon.
We basically rebuilt the game and fixed a lot of issues regarding hit detection.
There will be a completely new  hit-reg system, which works a lot better than the old one, some new levels and an overall polishing of the game.

When the update comes live is not yet known, but it will be soon!

We've created a Discord server where we post progress, announcements, and a development road map:

https://discord.gg/r8cDkdK

We will keep you informed,

Cheers!
